textos.Lançado em 2015 e dirigido por George Mi: Released in 2015 and directed by George Miller, Mad Max: Fury Road is an action and adventure science fiction film set in a post-apocalyptic landscape. In the story, the survivor Max Rockatansky is captured by rebels and finds himself in the middle of a deadly confrontation, deciding to help Imperator Furiosa escape from a ruthless tyrant.
textos.A experiência é estruturada em torno de: The experience is structured around continuous chase sequences in a desert environment, sustaining an accelerated cadence throughout its running time. The dynamic relies on the intensity of physical action and on the constant presence of visual and sound elements in the composition of the environment.
textos.Os grupos de avaliação convergem sobre o: The evaluation groups converge on the elements that make up the film and mainly debate the verdict on how well the work functions. Among the vast majority of ratings (~85%), most highlight the impressive visual and practical effects, while a large portion praise the intense, well-choreographed action sequences, and a good portion also point to the striking production design and characterization.
textos.Para quem se posiciona numa fração mínim: For those in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~12%), most assess the action and chases through the lens of wear, about half debate the characters and their development, and a significant share raise reservations about the pace and the running time. Lastly, from the standpoint of those who make up an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~4%), about half criticize the weak script and the lack of story, many point to a dragging, repetitive pace, and several mention uninteresting characters without charisma.
